title: Mission Control Approve-Next Button: Wire onClick to ai-proposals Review Endpoint
goal: The 'Approve next' button in MissionControlV3.tsx is currently a visual placeholder with no onClick handler — clicking it produces no effect. Wire it to POST /api/v1/runs/{run_id}/ai-proposals/{proposal_id}/review so operators can actually approve intrusive pivots from the UI. Same fix needed for the 'Pause' button.
scope: Modify ui-v2/src/components/screens/MissionControlV3.tsx Action row to derive the most recent pending intrusive proposal for the active run and wire the button to call the review endpoint with decision='approved'. Add a similar handler for Pause (sets a run-level pause flag).
generation_reason: Operator surfaced on 2026-05-15 during Phase 1 checkpoint #324 that clicking the Approve-next button has no effect. Code inspection confirmed MissionControlV3.tsx:244 has no onClick handler — pure cosmetic placeholder. The correct backend endpoint exists (POST /runs/{run_id}/ai-proposals/{proposal_id}/review at api/app/routers/runs.py:1921) but the UI is not calling it. This is a real operator workflow break: intrusive-tier governance shows the approval gate but cannot be acted on from the UI.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Approve-next + Pause button wiring only. Do NOT redesign the Action row layout, do NOT add new proposal types, do NOT change the underlying approval API contract.
constraints.no_governance_bypass: The new onClick must use the existing POST /runs/{run_id}/ai-proposals/{proposal_id}/review endpoint. Do not add a new bypass route. Server-side scope/tier governance remains authoritative.

success_criteria: MissionControlV3.tsx Approve-next button has an onClick handler that resolves the most recent pending intrusive AgentProposal for the active run and POSTs review with decision='approved'.
Button shows a loading state during the request and a brief success/error indicator on completion.
Pause button has an onClick handler that marks the run paused (existing run-state mechanism).
Playwright test covers the happy path: approval succeeds + UI updates run status.
If no pending proposal exists, button is disabled with a tooltip explaining why.

required_checks: cd ui-v2 && npm run test:e2e -- --grep approve-next
acceptance_criteria: Approve-next click results in actual POST to /api/v1/runs/{run_id}/ai-proposals/{proposal_id}/review.
UI state reflects the approval result (success/error).
No regression in Cinema, Kill, or other UI flows.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.
after_completion: Record in NEXT_TASK.md the next queued task or operator decision per Mythos plan continuation.

out_of_scope: Pause-button design beyond the simple click-to-pause action.
Multi-proposal selection UI (current behavior: most recent pending wins).
Approval audit trail UI surface (separate scope).
